regime_context: China A-shares show a single dominant narrative — Banks — sitting atop the momentum ranks with a high durability bar (0.75), trend tag, 0.83 breadth, and a crowding flag, while the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history (mean-reverting tape). Only 2 of 22 themes are trend-gate eligible, rotation breadth is very narrow, and past directional accuracy is weak (0.373), so this is a low-conviction leadership description, not a prediction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether the Banks leadership handoff begins to form: the challenger theme is Gold Miners (rank 2), but its durability bar is only 0.38 and it is not trend-gate eligible. A confirmed handoff would require Gold Miners to become eligible while Banks loses the eligibility or leadership margin narrows below ~0.1 — that observable would retire this watch.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks are the single eligible, trend-tagged leader with the highest durability bar (0.75) and decent breadth (0.83), which supports staying with the prevailing narrative while the trend remains intact. The crowding flag (z=1.82) is a size-down caution only, not a fade. Because the absolute-trend gate did not help on this tape, the lean is expressed as a conditional follow of the confirmed leader rather than an edge claim.
evidence: crowding_z 1.82, crowded=true (size-down caution, never a fade)
theses.dissent: Banks are already the most crowded theme and the market is flagged as mean-reverting; the trend gate has no drawdown-control value here, so the leadership can reverse quickly with no filter.

falsifier.text: The bank ETF 512800.SS closes below its 20-day simple moving average and stays there for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Software & AI Apps
theses.thesis: Software & AI Apps sit at rank 20 with a deeply negative score, a mean-revert tag, negligible breadth (0.067), and no trend-gate eligibility. There is no detector leg supporting participation here, and the mean-revert tag plus weak momentum argue against chasing a rebound in this theme.
theses.dissent: A sharp mean-reversion snapback in the most beaten-down tech themes could outpace the narrow bank-led tape, especially given the coincident macro narrative is dominated by ai_tech headlines.

falsifier.text: Software & AI Apps jumps into the top five of the momentum ranks and becomes trend-gate eligible before the check-by date, closing above its 50-day average for ten sessions.

theses.subject: Brokers & Securities
theses.thesis: Brokers rank 19 with one of the lowest durability bars (0.18), very low breadth (0.067), and zero eligibility. It sits in the same Financials & Value category as the dominant Banks leader but shows no strength, suggesting capital is concentrating in banks and not rotating through the broader financial complex — no detector leg supports a lean here.
evidence: eligible=false, same category as Banks leader
theses.dissent: If the bank-led financials narrative broadens out, brokers are a high-beta way to catch a catch-up trade from a crowded Banks theme.

falsifier.text: Brokers & Securities rises into the top five of the ranks and becomes eligible, with breadth above 0.5, before the check-by date.
